dish.title: Grilled Peach Burrito Bowl
dish.name: Grilled Peach Burrito Bowl
dish.description: Grilled peach slices over lime-seasoned rice and cumin black beans, with pickled red onion and cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Grilled Peach Burrito Bowl
recipe_version.description: Grilled peach slices over lime-seasoned rice and cumin black beans, with pickled red onion and cilantro.
recipe_version.doneness: Peach slices charred at the edges and still holding their shape, not collapsed. Beans heated through. Rice warm.

substitutions.pickled red onion: Use store-bought. A quick pickle is not specified here because v1 gave no brine.
substitutions.rice: Start from 3 cups cooked rice. Cooking rice from raw is extra time and is not inside the 25 minutes.

ingredients.name: peaches
ingredients.note: ripe but firm; pitted and cut into 1/2-inch slices

ingredients.name: black beans
ingredients.note: drained and rinsed, about 1 1/2 cups. Not increased. Peaches are the primary ingredient.

ingredients.name: cooked long-grain rice
ingredients.note: warm. About 1 cup dry, cooked ahead. The 25-minute clock does not include cooking rice from raw.

ingredients.name: pickled red onion
ingredients.note: store-bought. v1 also allowed quick-pickled onion but gave no brine, so this version does not invent one.

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: zest plus juice, split: zest and juice of 1/2 lime on the rice, juice of the remaining 1/2 lime in the beans

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: tossed with the peach slices so they can grill without tearing

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/4 tsp in the beans, 1/4 tsp tossed with the rice. Diamond Crystal. If Morton, use half.

steps.title: Grill the peaches
steps.body: Heat a grill to medium-high. Toss the peach slices with the neutral oil. Grill 2 minutes per side, until the edges are charred and the slices still hold their shape. This is a grill, not a stovetop. v1's method list said only stovetop.

steps.title: Warm the beans
steps.body: Warm the drained black beans with the cumin, the juice of 1/2 lime, and 1/4 tsp kosher salt over medium heat for 5 minutes, until heated through.

steps.title: Season the rice
steps.body: Toss the warm cooked long-grain rice with the zest of the lime, the juice of the remaining 1/2 lime, and the remaining 1/4 tsp kosher salt. v1 named the rice lime rice but never put lime on it, and it used only half of the lime in the beans.

steps.title: Assemble the bowls
steps.body: Layer rice, beans, grilled peaches, pickled red onion, and cilantro in bowls. The peaches stay on top, in slices. Four servings.

projection.allergen_note: No major allergen in this ingredient list. Dietary eligibility is separate: plant and dairy-free. Bowl is a format, not a diet and not an allergen.
